name: office-outlook-mcp
description: Outlook / Microsoft 365 for Claude — read mail, folders, calendar, contacts and tasks, and send mail with confirmation

outlook_access_token.title: Outlook Access Token (optional)
outlook_access_token.description: A pre-obtained Outlook bearer token. Leave blank to capture one from your signed-in Outlook browser tab via the ContextMint Bridge extension.

outlook_disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable browser capture (advanced)
outlook_disable_fetchproxy.description: Set to '1' to disable browser capture, requiring OUTLOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN.

outlook_api_base.title: Outlook REST base URL (advanced)
outlook_api_base.description: Override the Outlook REST base URL. Defaults to https://outlook.office.com/api/v2.0.

outlook_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
outlook_ws_port.description: fetchproxy concentrator port used for token capture. Defaults to 37149, the fleet-wide shared port.

outlook_capture_timeout.title: Token capture timeout in seconds (advanced)
outlook_capture_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the Outlook tab to make a request we can read a token from. Defaults to 30.

outlook_token_cache.title: Cache the captured token (advanced)
outlook_token_cache.description: Set to 'false' to stop caching the captured token between runs. Defaults to true.

outlook_token_file.title: Token cache file (advanced)
outlook_token_file.description: Path to the cached token file. Defaults to ~/.office-outlook-mcp/token.json.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
